user.title: Ambidash
user.description: Ambidash builds a dashboard from your floors, areas and devices. After setup, add it under Settings → Dashboards → Add dashboard → Ambidash.

init.title: Photos from the internet
init.description: Dashboards can show free placeholder photos (Wikimedia, NASA, Lorem Picsum, Bing) as their background. Home Assistant fetches and serves them itself; your devices never contact those sites. Nothing is fetched until a dashboard asks for placeholder photos.

data_description.external_photos: Turn off to stop all fetching; dashboards then show their background colour instead.

photos_disabled.title: A dashboard asks for photos from the internet
photos_disabled.description: A dashboard uses placeholder photos as its background, but fetching them is switched off. Turn it on under Settings → Devices & services → Ambidash → Configure, or remove `placeholder` from the dashboard.
